name: SmartbedMQTT
description: This project aims to enable remote control of adjustable smart beds (via MQTT) from HomeAssistant. See project page for full details and config file options. Support is for Sleeptracker AI (Tempur Ergo/Extend, BeautyRest SmartMotion, and Serta Perfect Smart Base) ErgoWifi ErgoMotion Logicdata Richmat Linak Solace MotoSleep Reverie Leggett & Platt (Okin & Richmat variants) Okimat Keeson Octo
